column1: # The capitals of Walters Ms. W.541: the red initials that
# open its sentences, each the average of its copies on the
# pages named (one copy: the one most like the others),
# Pictures: the ink alone, as large as written; the font
# Ո: its top edge smoothed of a mark written above it.
# Տ: one copy, a smudge at its top end cleaned. Ը, Ծ, Ձ:
# one copy each, ragged edges smoothed. Ձ has a stroke
# across its foot; Չ, the same 2 without it. Խ, Ճ, Է, Ժ, Շ: one
# copy each, found on the pages where the Gospels have a
# sentence that starts with them. Ռ and Ց are not in W.541
# as initials: they are from W.542 (../w542/, pages of that
# book), named by the user. Ղ Ջ Ր are found in neither:
# Claude composed them from his own capitals (copies 0):
# Ր his Ո with the right leg ended short, Ղ his Լ with the
# hump of his Ի, Ջ his Չ with a short stroke across it.
